name: Certified AI Revenue Cycle Specialist
description: AI in medical billing, coding, claims, denials and prior authorization for US healthcare organizations.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: Certified AI Revenue Cycle Specialist

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must hold a current course certificate for each of these courses: AI for Medical Billing and Coding Specialists: CPT, ICD-10-CM, HCPCS and Claim Edits (HLS-155); AI for Healthcare Administration and Revenue Cycle Professionals (HLS-150); Building AI for Claims, Denials and Prior Authorization (HLS-255); Building and Deploying AI in Health Plans and Revenue Cycle (HLS-250). Every course certificate must be current (not revoked or expired) when the program certificate is issued; the program certificate is renewed when every course certificate is current again.

Each course exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a program certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
